WalueDashboard

Connect WhatsApp to Your Business

Seamlessly integrate WhatsApp Business API with your Frappe/ERPNext system. Send messages, automate workflows, and engage customers directly from your CRM.

  • Template & Interactive Messages
  • Voice Calls via WhatsApp
  • Seamless CRM Integration
  • Real-time Delivery Status

Get Started Free

Setup takes less than 5 minutes

Your ERPNext or Frappe Cloud site URL

How It Works

Three simple steps to connect WhatsApp to your business

1. Register

Create your account with basic business details and select a plan that fits your needs.

2. Connect WhatsApp

Link your WhatsApp Business Account through Meta's secure embedded signup flow.

3. Install & Go

One-click setup on your Frappe site. Start sending messages immediately.
